title: Single-view echocardiography-based deep learning for pulmonary hypertension detection: a multi-level supervised and explainable approach.
summary: A single-view echocardiography deep-learning system detected pulmonary hypertension using multi-level supervision and explainability in the reported clinical cohorts.
ai_technology: The learned image model used single-view echocardiography with multi-level supervision and explainability to classify pulmonary hypertension
organization: Department of Ultrasound, Beijing Chaoyang Hospital Affiliated to Capital Medical University, Beijing, China;; School of Mechatronics Engineering, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing, China

evidence.tested: A single-view echocardiography deep-learning system detected pulmonary hypertension using multi-level supervision and explainability in the reported clinical cohorts. Evaluation: Cohort testing, comparator analyses and reported explainability checks provide bounded diagnostic validation; no deployment or outcome benefit is claimed.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the reported clinical cohorts and reference standard; prospective deployment or patient-outcome benefit is not established.
evidence.ai_role: The learned image model used single-view echocardiography with multi-level supervision and explainability to classify pulmonary hypertension.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
